tasks.name: Design User Interface
tasks.description: Create the layout and design for the web application, including upload and input fields.

tasks.name: Implement Image Upload Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the feature that allows users to upload a product image.

tasks.name: Implement Needs Description Input
tasks.description: Develop the feature that allows users to input their needs in a sentence.

tasks.name: Develop Content Generation Logic
tasks.description: Create the backend logic to generate product titles and selling points based on user input.

tasks.name: Set Up Database
tasks.description: Configure a database to store user inputs and generated content.

tasks.name: Integrate Frontend with Backend
tasks.description: Connect the frontend interface with the backend logic to ensure seamless data flow.

tasks.name: Test Application Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure all features work correctly and the application meets requirements.

tasks.name: Deploy Application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a server and make it accessible to users.

T1.implementation_approach: Use a design tool like Figma or Adobe XD to create wireframes and prototypes. Implement the design using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks like React or Vue.js.
T1.notes: Focus on responsive design and accessibility standards.

T2.implementation_approach: Use a frontend form to accept image files and send them to the backend via an API. On the backend, validate and store the image using a file storage system or cloud storage.
T2.notes: Ensure proper validation for file type and size. Implement security measures to prevent malicious uploads.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a form with input fields for the needs description. Use state management to handle input data and validate it before submission.
T3.notes: Provide real-time validation and user feedback for better UX.

T4.implementation_approach: Use a rule-based or AI-driven approach to generate content. For AI, integrate an NLP model like OpenAI's GPT API to generate text based on user input.
T4.notes: Ensure the generated content is relevant and contextually accurate.

T5.implementation_approach: Choose a database (SQL or NoSQL) based on requirements. Design the schema, set up tables/collections, and configure the database connection in the backend.
T5.notes: Optimize the schema for scalability and performance.

T6.implementation_approach: Use RESTful APIs or GraphQL to connect the frontend with the backend. Implement API calls in the frontend and handle responses appropriately.
T6.notes: Ensure proper error handling and loading states for a seamless user experience.

T7.implementation_approach: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Use testing frameworks to automate the process and ensure all functionalities work as expected.
T7.notes: Focus on edge cases and ensure high test coverage.

T8.implementation_approach: Set up a CI/CD pipeline to automate the deployment process. Use cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Vercel to host the application.
T8.notes: Ensure the application is secure and scalable. Monitor performance post-deployment.
